input: Find nature, outdoor adventure, farm, horseback riding and fishing summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Black Mountain, Swannanoa, Montreat and Old Fort, NC. Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
searches: Black Mountain Swannanoa outdoor nature summer camp 2026
Swannanoa summer camp farm Warren Wilson 2026

candidates.name: Camp Grier
candidates.note: 2027 day and overnight camps; equestrian, rock-climbing and canoeing sessions.

candidates.name: Camp Rockmont
candidates.note: Boys’ overnight camps ages 7–17 and coed day camp; paddling, mountain biking and wilderness skills.

candidates.name: Camp Merri-Mac
candidates.note: Girls’ overnight camp with horseback riding, backpacking, climbing and paddling.

candidates.name: Camp Timberlake
candidates.note: 2027 boys’ overnight sessions for grades 1–11; summer campus is in Marion, not Black Mountain.

candidates.name: Ridgecrest Foundation — Ridgecrest Summer Camps
candidates.note: Runs Camp Ridgecrest for Boys and Camp Crestridge for Girls; riding and wilderness camping programs.

candidates.name: Montreat Conference Center
candidates.note: Summer Clubs day camp for children through graduating teens; outdoor recreation and wilderness activities.

candidates.name: Montreat College
candidates.note: COMPASS Outdoor Recreation Studies ran June 21–25, 2026, with outdoor exploration and adventure recreation.

candidates.name: The Learning Community
candidates.note: Nature day camp on Bee Tree Creek; also Summer Academy with academics, makerspace and forest play.

candidates.name: Higher Ground Adventures
candidates.note: Weeklong overnight adventure camp; July 12–18, 2026 session served Black Mountain Home for Children youth.

candidates.name: North Carolina Outward Bound School
candidates.note: Teen wilderness expeditions; 2026 Swannanoa listings included Appalachian backpacking and rock climbing for ages 12–16.

candidates.name: Black Mountain Recreation & Parks
candidates.note: Summer day camp for rising grades 1–6, exploring parks, walking trails, creeks and local attractions.

candidates.name: KidQuest
candidates.note: Day camp for rising grades 1–6 with weekly hiking, outdoor discovery, field trips and swimming.

candidates.name: PASSPORT
candidates.note: PASSPORTkids residential camp at Montreat with canoeing, paddle-boating, swimming and hiking opportunities.

candidates.name: YMCA of the Triangle — Y Guides
candidates.note: Parent-child camping weekends at Camp Rockmont in August 2026, with paddling, archery and other outdoor activities.
